The matching paper is DeCode: Decoupling Content and Delivery for Medical QA by Po-Jen Ko, Chen-Han Tsai, and Yu-Shao Peng [1]. It presents DeCode, a training-free, model-agnostic framework that adapts existing LLMs to produce contextualized answers in clinical settings by decoupling content and delivery [1].

According to the abstract, DeCode is evaluated on OpenAI HealthBench and improves zero-shot performance from 28.4% to 49.8%, achieving a new state of the art compared to existing methods [1]. The paper’s focus is improving clinical relevance and validity of LLM responses, especially when standard models are factually correct but poorly aligned with individual patient contexts [1].
